note: This sheet is RGB with no alpha channel, so it slices to one fused piece. That piece has been cut on its stated 25x26 grid, so the entries below are its cells in reading order - left to right, then top to bottom - one cell each and none of them annotated yet. Cut once, then annotate: slicing finds the plate as one fused piece again, so re-slicing has nothing to add. 1225x1284 at 25x26. It already ships as a hand-written tileset built by art-source/tilesets/normalize_tilesets.py. Exporting over it would rewrite the ids and coordinates that GenMappingRegistry references, so treat this as a sheet to inspect or adopt deliberately, not to re-export casually. Most of its cells are ground variants selected by pool membership rather than props, so adopting it means authoring blocks, not doodads.
